candidates.change_summary: Replace the inner call selector from 'transferFrom(address,address,uint256)' to 'transfer(address,uint256)' so the external call uses a different function signature.
Replace 'require(_tos.length > 0)' with 'require(_tos.length > 1)' so the function reverts if only one address is provided.
Replace the revert on call failure with a 'continue' statement, so failed sub-calls are silently skipped instead of reverting the whole transaction.
Replace the loop body so that the same amount is transferred only to the first address in the array, ignoring all others.
Delete the require statement so calls with an empty array no longer revert and the function returns true without any external call.
